description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange with effect from 09.08.2021 to 15.08.2021
reasoning: This gazette notification is a Customs Notification issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) by the Director General of Customs. It sets new official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges, and rescinds a previous notification. This content falls squarely under the definition of "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" (Type 5), which includes "Regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements" and "Legal notices and statutory declarations." While a government official is named, this is incidental to the core regulatory function of the notice; it does not announce a personnel change or describe the official's portfolio responsibilities, so it does not qualify for a government-related classification (Types 1-3).
